text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't have any text. It starts with pure darkness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's something crouching in that darkness. A silhouette… that kind of looks like Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The shadowy figure is crying in the darkness. She looks so sad and lonely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, a small light appears in the darkness, and the little shadow begins to walk toward the light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she continues walking, the light grows stronger and stronger. It grows radiant, until finally…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The light turns into the sun. The darkness is dispelled, and the world is illuminated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sun's warm light washes over the shadowy figure, revealing her true form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the final page, the girl, once consumed by shadows, is now prancing around joyfully in the world of light.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I wanted to show this book to you before anyone else.
